profile.dividendPolicy:
The company has a policy to pay dividends at a rate of no less than 40.00% of net profit after corporate income tax, based on the individual financial statements, and after deducting all types of reserves as required by law and the company's regulations. The dividend payment will not have a significant impact on the company's normal operations.
However, the dividend payment may be subject to change depending on the company's performance, financial position, liquidity, business expansion plans, future needs, and other factors deemed appropriate by the company's management. The pay will also consider the best interests of the shareholders, as determined by the Board of Directors and/or the shareholders.
